notes:
## StraboMicro2 v2.0.55

### New Features
- Quick Spot Presets: copy between Global and Project, export and import a file, number keys per project, note that only Project presets are shared; e2e 40
- Edit Micrograph Location and Set Micrograph Scale show the micrograph's name and thumbnail, plus (2 of 4) during a by-hand run (Jason, 2026-10-30); e2e 38
- Collaborators dialog: Open on StraboSpot... (owner) goes to the website's Collaborators page for pasted lists and join links; e2e 39; npm run test:load, a workshop load test of the server (25 people, downloads, live session)
- Finish Importing: one wizard for micrographs batch imported with or without instrument info, opened by clicking an incomplete one and by the end of Batch Import: the micrographs (checked list), Rotate / Flip (only while nothing depends on the pixels), Instrument & Image Info + Instrument Data once for all with an image type per micrograph, then the placement choices with equal weight (Find each one, Cover the full area, Copy the placement, Place by hand one at a time) or the scale (Jason, 2026-10-30). Cancel changes nothing, nothing is remembered. Fixes rotation offered on a placed micrograph. Batch Import: instrument info on by default, image types per file. Replaces CompleteInstrumentInfoDialog and the place-all question. test:finish-importing (31), e2e 38 (5, mutation-checked), e2e 20 updated
- Clicking an unplaced micrograph with unplaced siblings offers every choice equally: Only <name> (Choose a location method...: Edit Micrograph Location) or All N (Find each one, Cover the full area, Copy the placement), no highlighted button (Jason, 2026-10-30). Shared PlaceAllChoices, also the last screen of Batch Import. Place automatically on parent is now the last location method in Edit Micrograph Location and the wizard. e2e 20 updated
- View > Show Parent Spots: on a micrograph, the spots of every micrograph above it, mapped into its pixels through the placements (scaled rectangle with rotation, 3-point registration; a point placement stops the chain), cut off at its edges, faded and dashed, labelled with their micrograph; not selectable; right-click > Go to Spot on <micrograph> (Peter, 2026-10-29). Remembered like Show Recursive Spots. src/utils/parentSpots.ts (transformSpot shared with ChildSpotsRenderer) + test:parent-spots (12); e2e 35 (mutation-checked); e2e 13, 21, 24, 29 still pass
- View > Micrograph Visibility... (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+V): a panel listing the micrographs placed under the one in the viewer, indented as in the tree; show/hide each, Show only this one (keeps its parents) with Up/Down to step through them, a name filter for Show All / Hide All, and each micrograph's opacity (Jason + Peter, 2026-10-29). Visibility is each person's own view. src/utils/micrographVisibility.ts + test:micrograph-visibility (12); e2e 34 (mutation-checked); e2e 13, 24 still pass
- Copy scale from an existing micrograph: a scale method (Edit Micrograph Location + New Associated Micrograph wizard, rectangle and point) that takes the px/cm of any micrograph in the project; the placement step starts with it as a filled-in Pixel Conversion Factor (px per 1 cm) and the save stores it exactly; a note when the pixel sizes differ (Peter, 2026-10-29). PlacementCanvas works out the Pixel Conversion scale again once the parent image has loaded (filled-in fields were read before it, so the image was drawn at the wrong size). test:parent-area 24; e2e 32 (2 tests, mutation-checked incl. the drawn size); e2e 14, 21, 30, 31 still pass
- Place unplaced children like...: every checked unplaced child copies the location, scale and rotation of a placed child chosen as the model (rules of Copy location and scale: same proportions, a different pixel size scales by width with a note; 3-point registration copies get their own overlay tiles), one undo step (Peter, 2026-10-29: a stack of EDS maps of one area). Shared PlaceUnplacedChildrenDialog with the full-area mode; the end of Batch Import offers Same area / Like a placed one... / Place automatically. test:parent-area 20; e2e 31 (2 tests, mutation-checked); e2e 20, 30 still pass
- Same area as parent: a child micrograph covers its parent exactly (offset 0, rotation 0, scale = parent scale x child width / parent width; same proportions only), as a location method in Edit Micrograph Location and the New Associated Micrograph wizard, and for every unplaced child at once from the parent's menu (Place unplaced children on its full area..., one undo step) (Peter, 2026-10-29: EDS maps nested in the BSE image). Stored as a plain scaled rectangle. test:parent-area (13); e2e 30 (3 tests, mutation-checked); e2e 20 still passes
- Overlapping spots: spots are drawn larger polygons first, then lines, then points, so a smaller spot inside a larger one is on top and gets the click (saved order unchanged; sorted once per spot change); the spot right-click menu has Select Spot Here listing every spot under the cursor, top first, when there is more than one (Peter, 2026-10-29). src/utils/spotStacking.ts + test:spot-stacking (16); e2e 29 (both halves mutation-checked); e2e 16, 19, 23, 24, 29 19 passed
- Quick Spot Presets can add tags (Project presets only; tags belong to a project, a Global preset's Tags section says so): data.tags (tag ids) is added to the spot when the preset is applied (Quick Edit/Apply, auto spot mode), never twice, deleted tags left out; choosing the preset in Create New Spot adds its tags to the Tags field, which is final at save. Shared TagPicker (New Spot + preset editor). test:new-spot 49; e2e 28 third test (mutation-checked); e2e 16, 22, 25, 28 14 passed
- Create New Spot has a Tags field: the spot is put in the chosen project tags (spot.tags) as it is made, and the next New Spot in the project starts with the tags chosen last (this session) (Peter, 2026-10-29). No tags yet: the field says to create them in the Tags tab. Tag dot style shared with the Tags tab (src/utils/tagSwatch.ts). test:new-spot 41; e2e 28 (2 tests, mutation-checked); e2e 16 still passes
- Mineral pickers accept names that are not in the mineral list (e.g. lithic fragments, glass; Peter, 2026-10-29): 'Use "..."' ends the list when the typed text matches no mineral, the project's custom names are offered again (no second spelling), marked 'not in mineral list'. Saved as the plain name in the existing fields. Selected names not in the database are no longer dropped from the picker (they were lost on the next change); legacy lowercase names keep their spelling. Spot labels show a custom name whole. src/utils/customMinerals.ts + test:custom-minerals (10); e2e 27 new test (mutation-checked)
- Properties panel: Links is always shown for a spot or micrograph, like Notes and Associated Files ('No links' when empty, count chip only with links), so its pencil is the visible way to add a link (Jason, 2026-10-28: a PI's earlier request; b4d9651 made Notes and Associated Files always shown but left Links out). e2e 23 checks a spot and a micrograph without links (mutation-checked: old condition fails); 17, 22, 24 pass
- View > Filter Spots... (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+F; Angus, 2026-10-28): a panel in the viewer's top-left corner with every spot data section (Add Data order + Custom User Data), each Any / Has / Doesn't have, combined with AND; spots that don't match are dimmed (default) or hidden on the image, in recursive spots and in the Spots tab, have no label and are not picked by the lasso; a notice in the bottom-left corner shows 'Filtered: n of m spots match' with Edit and Clear. View setting only (not saved, cleared when a project opens or closes). New src/utils/spotDataSections.ts (hasContent looks inside for real values, SPOT_DATA_SECTIONS, filter helpers); the Properties panel uses the same test to show a section, so empty sections (e.g. a mineral list emptied to []) no longer show. test:spot-data-sections 55
- Edit n Spots adds links to every selected spot (Angus, 2026-10-28). New Links row: links in its list are appended to each spot's links, a URL the spot already has is skipped (src/utils/spotLinks.ts addLinks), spots with nothing to change are left alone, one undo step. A link filled in but not added asks first (Add before applying?: Back / Apply Without It / Add and Apply), like Add before saving? in Mineralogy; LinkAddForm reports its text via optional onDraftChange. Tests: test:spot-links 12, e2e 23 (2, mutation-checked: no duplicate skip, no question)
- Sync needs your decision names who made their change (Peter, 2026-10-27: 'theirs' is not enough for a class sharing one project). Each conflict field is credited to the newest feed entry that changed its value (user + time from the change feed, no server change; electron/sync/changeAuthors.js), kept in sync/state.json with the conflict and carried over by later pulls; delete questions name who deleted it or who changed things in it (newest first), also when a conflict turns into a 'you deleted it' question. Dialog: "Fred Smith's · changed 10:21 AM" in place of Theirs, "Keep all Fred Smith's" when one person made every change, "Fred Smith deleted ..."; this account on another computer = "You, on another computer"; conflicts stored before this show Theirs as before. Tests: test:change-authors 15, test:decision-text 21, test:pull 42 (editor account changes the same field), test:decisions 66 (mutation-checked); e2e 02 expects Ana's name
- Mineralogy/Lithology dialog: Save with a mineral or lithology chosen but not added asks first ('Add before saving?': Back / Save Without It / Add and Save), which also shows that Add is what puts it in the list (Jason, 2026-10-25: a preset mineral picked without Add was silently dropped). LithologyPicker reports its not-yet-added selection (onPendingChange). Each opening now starts with an empty Mineral field in preset mode too (the preset editor keeps the dialog mounted, so the last picked mineral stayed). e2e 22-preset-mineralogy 2 (mutation-checked: no question, no reset)
- Project tab shows a Custom User Data section when the project has any: a count and Show Custom User Data..., which opens the same table as the micrograph one for the whole project, with Sample and Micrograph columns; clicking a row goes to that spot (switches micrograph, selects, zooms, like a chat spot link). Download saves the whole project; Remove column / Remove all as before. e2e 17 'Project tab' (mutation-checked: select-only row click fails)
- Place children automatically: one command places every unplaced child of a micrograph (PlaceChildrenDialog: one worker for all, parent reads kept; result list with found checked, low confidence unchecked, ambiguous/no match left for Edit Location; footprints on the parent; Stop keeps results; one save = one undo step; composites regenerated); offered at the end of an associated Batch Import, and when an unplaced child with unplaced siblings is clicked (Just this one stops asking for that parent); tree menu item Place children automatically...; shared helpers: micrographLocation.ts (hasLocation for the tree, export check and batch), placementUpdates (Edit Location + batch), createPlacer/mustPlaceAffine/bakeAffineOutcome, FootprintPreview; tests for the helpers
- Place automatically on parent, stage 3: Edit Micrograph Location (new Location Method, Scale Method step skipped, rectangle saved with offset/rotation/scale, affine saved like 3-Point Registration, place by hand on no match); e2e 20: an unplaced micrograph (as after a batch import) placed from the tree; fixtures: images for added micrographs
- Place automatically on parent, stage 2: New Micrograph wizard (new Location Method, Scale Method step skipped; AutoPlacementPanel runs the matcher in placeWorker.ts, reading image regions through the new image:read-gray-region IPC; rectangle result opens PlacementCanvas pre-filled via initialPlacement, affine result bakes tiles like 3-Point Registration with a footprint preview and Adjust points; saved as affine when an ancestor is affine-placed; ambiguous/no match offer placing by hand); placementFields.ts (rectangle/affine fields, file -> stored pixel sizes) with tests; e2e 20-auto-place (turned detail saved with the right place and scale, sheared detail saved as affine with tiles, unrelated image)
- Place automatically on parent, stage 1: matching engine (src/services/autoPlace/placementMatch.ts; bundled OpenCV.js AKAZE + RANSAC affine; detail tried at several sizes, sheared versions when nothing fits; burned-in graphics masked; label-only, mirrored and off-parent fits refused; ambiguous when a second location fits about as well; rectangle unless the affine fits clearly better; large parents refined on a full-resolution crop); npm run test:auto-place (76: math, synthetic details with known placements from the Toxaway images, real Toxaway pairs, circle drawings; mutation-checked)
- Grain Spot GPU self-check: before the GPU encoder is used, it analyzes a built-in test image and its result is compared with the CPU's (encoderCheck.ts EXPECTED, 384 values; relative difference at most 0.05; a correct M4 Pro GPU differs by 0.00003); a GPU that gets it wrong is not used (console says why); npm run test:grain-encoder-check (computes/checks EXPECTED, catches 10 % off, scrambled, NaN, missing); STRABO_E2E_GRAIN_BAD_GPU for e2e 19 (faulty GPU -> CPU)
- W picks the Grain Spot tool (like P, L, G and M for the other spot tools); e2e 19 checks it
- Grain Spot on the GPU: the image encoder runs through WebGPU where there is one (0.13-0.19 s a view on an M4 Pro instead of 1.1-1.3 s), else on the CPU; a GPU error or non-numbers moves it to the CPU for good; model is now the fp16 encoder + int8 decoder (76 MB; closer to full precision than int8, as fast on the CPU), new folder sam2.1-hiera-tiny, old int8 folder removed after the download; worker uses onnxruntime-web/webgpu (the default build's WebGPU path gives wrong outlines with fp16) with the asyncify files; tooltip says GPU or CPU; STRABO_E2E_GRAIN_CPU for tests; e2e 19 runs on GPU and CPU
- Grain Spot refine clicks: Shift+click adds to the last grain, Cmd/Ctrl+click cuts from it; the same spot gets the new outline (one undo step each; refining continues after an undo, not after a hand edit); holding the key previews the result; clicks kept in image coordinates (GrainPrompt); outline picks the best scored candidate that holds the added points and not the cut ones; a click whose view is replaced by a newer one (tiles after a zoom) asks again in it instead of failing; status line hint; test:grain-outline 43, e2e 19 refine scenario
- Grain Spot hover preview: the grain under the mouse is outlined before clicking (cyan; dashed orange when it runs off the screen); newest mouse position wins, one outline at a time (useGrainSpotTool hoverAtScreen/clearHover); none over a spot, after a click, while panning or outside the viewer; drawn by GrainPreviewOutline so the viewer does not redraw; e2e 19 checks it
- Grain Spot tool: magic-wand button on the drawing toolbar; the view on screen is analyzed after each pan or zoom (useGrainSpotTool), a click outlines the grain and saves it as a polygon spot through placeSpot (auto spot mode names, presets, Option/Alt, one undo step each); a click inside a spot selects it; a grain running off the screen or no grain says so in the status line (GrainSpotStatus); first use offers the model download; isSpotTool shared by the spot tools; e2e 19-grain-spot (outline within 1.4% of the fixture grain's area)
- Grain Spot building blocks: SAM 2.1 tiny int8 model download (electron/grainSpotModel.js, pinned revision, SHA-256 checked, IPC grainspot:*), worker that analyzes a view once and outlines a grain per click (src/services/grainSpot/samWorker.ts), engine with status store (grainSpotEngine.ts), outline math (src/utils/grainOutline.ts: piece under the click, holes filled, marching squares, Douglas-Peucker; npm run test:grain-outline 32); shared onnxruntime-web paths (src/services/ortWasm.ts)
- Debug > Sync: Expire My Access Token (dev builds): the next sync check renews the login, so a session the server ended shows the logged-out notice at once
- Web viewer shows Custom User Data: a spot's values, a micrograph's count and table (row click selects the spot, Download CSV); display rules shared with the app (src/utils/customUserData.ts, tableToCsv matches the desktop CSV); download names trimmed
- PDF export: each spot page lists its Custom User Data (header: value, in column order); the order rule is repeated in pdfReactExport.js for the server's PDF service and checked against the app's
- Custom User Data in the right pane: a spot's values (open by default), a micrograph's count with Show Custom User Data... (table of its spots; row click selects the spot; Download .xlsx/.csv; Remove column and Remove All for Owner/Editor, each one undo step); shared download helper; e2e 17 right-pane scenario
- Tools > Custom User Data...: download the template (.xlsx with locked spot columns and an Instructions sheet, or .csv), import a filled one with a preview, one undo step (electron/customUserDataFiles.js, npm run test:custom-user-data-files, e2e 17-custom-user-data)
- Custom User Data model: values on each spot (spot.customUserData), column order on the project (project.customUserDataColumns, merged as a set); template rows, import check with preview plan, apply, remove, Contributor rules (src/utils/customUserData.ts, npm run test:custom-user-data); serializer saves both fields; sync dialogs show headers as typed
- Manual screenshot runner (npm run manual:screenshots): real app copies driven like the e2e tests take the user manual's figures at 2x (main window, tools, micrographs and spots, sketches, sync and collaboration with three e2e accounts) and annotate-overview.js draws the labeled overview; e2e copies accept extra Chromium switches (E2E_ELECTRON_ARGS)
- Auto spot mode step 5: each auto spot is its own undo step (asOwnUndoStep), however quick the clicks (test:undo-history, e2e 16; both fail before)
- Auto strip moves to the top center of the viewer, just below the top ruler (the status line was easy to miss)
- Auto strip moves to the status line under the viewer (beside the toolbar it covered the image); picker shows the preset name, status text no longer wraps
- A drag pans the image while a spot tool is active (point, line, polygon); grabbing cursor once a drag starts; e2e 16 pan test (fails before)
- Auto spot mode 4b: clicks and closed lines/polygons save at once with the next name and preset, tool stays active, Alt/Option opens New Spot filled in, Esc ends the run, keys 1-9 pick the preset
- Auto spot mode 4a: personal setting (store, persisted), Auto button on the drawing toolbar, auto strip with preset picker and Next name
- Auto spot name patterns: project default (Edit Project > Default Spot Name) and per preset (preset editor > Spot Name); ordinary synced fields (test:entity-model)
- Auto spot names: {n} patterns, default 'Spot {n}', next number from the highest used in the sample (npm run test:auto-spot-name)
- Turn-on sync dialog warns about incomplete micrographs (decision B, 2026-10-07). 'Sync this project to StraboSpot' lists micrographs that need a scale, a location or instrument details (findIncompleteMicrographs, the export check; first 5, then 'and N more') with a note that syncing can start now and they can be finished later; Start Syncing is never disabled by it, since live sync sends half-finished work anyway. Wording in src/utils/incompleteMicrographs.ts; npm run test:incomplete-micrographs 16 (mutation caught)
- Project chat, stage C4: notifications and unread badge (spec v3 17bh). electron/chatNotify.js: an OS notification for messages from other people when neither the main nor the chat window is focused ('<name> in <project>', first line), silent, a click opens the chat; at most one per project per 30 s, later ones grouped ('3 new messages in <project>', 'From Ana and Ben'); nothing for what was read here or on another computer or seen meanwhile; notifications closed on quit. Unread total on the macOS Dock and Linux launcher (app.setBadgeCount), a red count overlay on the Windows taskbar (16 x 16 bitmap drawn in main, 9+ above 9). Preferences: Chat section with 'Chat notifications' (on by default), kept by main in userData/chat-window.json (saveState now merges); IPC chat:notifications / chat:set-notifications, window.api.chat.notifications/setNotifications. chat.js emits 'closed' when a chat stops (Close Project, logout) so the badge clears. Tests: npm run test:chat-notify 36 (3 mutations caught, one after adding the read-then-new case); test:chat 59; e2e 12-chat new test: badge, switch off then on, notification text, never for my own, offline 'Not sent yet' then sent, owner deletes another member's message, removed member loses chip and badge; 12-chat 8/8 over 4 repeats. e2e harness: Copy.close kills a copy that has not quit after 15 s (a copy with a chat window now and then stalls on quit under Playwright's inspector, also on C3 code, about 1 in 6)
- Project chat, stage C3: chat window and header chip (spec v3 17bd-17bf). electron/chatWindow.js: an independent window (no parent, falls behind the main window) for the project open in the main window: about 360 x 520 beside it, then its own place and pin remembered (userData/chat-window.json), keep-on-top pin, not in the Windows taskbar, title 'Chat: <name>', the close button hides it, destroyed on Close Project, logout and when the main window closes (a hidden window would block macOS activate). Page chat.html -> src/chat (second Vite input, 12 KB of its own; theme from src/theme.ts, followed through localStorage). ChatApp: messages with author runs, day and New lines, web links, links to spots/micrographs (names from the main window; a click selects the item there), delete (own; owner any), Load earlier messages, outgoing messages with Not sent yet / Retry / Discard, link to selection, Enter sends, character counter near 4,000; read while focused at the bottom. ChatChip left of the sync chip, only with another member (17be g), unread badge; also answers the chat window's selection/resolve requests. syncController opens the chat with the live follow and keeps the chat window on the open project (switching projects keeps it, 1.5 s). chat.js: rechecks members when an unknown person appears in presence (Ben accepting shows Ana's chip at once) and keeps the role. e2e harness ignores chat.html when finding the main page. Tests: test:chat-text 29, test:chat 59, e2e 12-chat (solo no chip, chip on join, unread then read, link to selection selects in the other copy, delete, close hides, pin; 2 mutations caught); full e2e 52 passed, 1 skipped; live 47, presence 35, sync-chip 80; typecheck + e2e typecheck clean
- Project chat, stage C2: main-process chat service (spec v3 17bd-17bi). electron/sync/chat.js keeps the open synced project's chat (messages, rev, unread, lastRead, others for the chip) and sends every change to all windows (chat:event state, plus incoming = new messages from other people after the first load, never my own from any computer). Outbox: each message gets a clientMsgId and waits until the server has it (offline = 'Not sent yet', 429 = waits retryAfter, refused = failed until retried or discarded), kept on disk across a quit, sent in order (a slowed-down or offline one holds the rest back), a lost answer never posts twice. Live chat/chatread notices (live.js) fetch since=rev or clear the count read on another computer; without the live channel it checks every 30 s; members are checked on open, every 2 min and when someone writes while the count is 0. IPC chat:open/close/state/send/retry/discard/delete/older/read in syncService (logout closes all), window.api.chat in preload + types. npm run test:chat 59 (fake server + dev server through syncService and strabo-live: live delivery in under 1.5 s, moderation, read on another computer, older pages, removal); 8 mutations caught incl. a real order bug found by the test (a slowed-down message was skipped). live 47, sync-service 44, sync-engine 36, pull 35, sync-chip 80, presence 35, typecheck clean
- Activity panel: the project's first upload is one line, 'You put the project on StraboSpot (...)', and a new item's files are part of its 'added' line (refs-only changes by the same person up to 10 min after it was added) instead of 'changed 17 micrographs'. Upload = the project's creation and the creations after it by the same person, each at most 60 s after the one before, up to the first change of another kind. The line's key and time are its newest change; every seq kept. Same rules on the website (server feature/microsync-history-upload-line). test:activity-feed 45 (12 new; 9 fail without the fold)
- Debug > Open .smz as a Separate Copy... (dev builds and npm run dev only): imports the file under a new project id named '<name> (copy)', so a copy of someone's real project can be synced in tests without linking to (or converting) the original on StraboSpot (pre-release gap 4). The Open Project dialog's asSeparateCopy mode reuses the existing asCopy import. Checked with a throwaway e2e scenario: new id, ' (copy)' name, not synced, Turn On Sync makes its own server project; typecheck clean
- Open Remote Project rows say who is in each project ('only you', '3 people', from the server's new member count; left out by an older server) and, when two projects share a name, their StraboSpot project number. Found in a hand test: a restored project and the owner's re-synced kept copy (a new project with the same name) looked alike. test:remote-rows 8 checks
- Presence (R3, spec 17al-17an): the app reports here/away (window focused and input within 5 min), the micrograph I view and the item I edit (shape editing, or an edit dialog) over the live channel; main keeps the latest per project and sends it whenever the project is followed (also when it was set before the follow). Others show as initials badges in a stable color per account, faded when away: in the header next to the sync chip, on tree micrographs they view, 'editing' on the tree row, spot list row and Properties panel header of what they edit, and 'Here now' at the top of Activity. An edit dialog opened through an EditingScope (Properties panel, bottom panel, tree, viewer, Edit Project) says what I edit, and shows 'Ben Ito is editing this spot right now. You can still edit; if you both change the same field you'll be asked which to keep.' at the top when someone else edits the same item (a hint, nothing locked; view-only dialogs are not editing). My own other computers are not shown; nothing shows while the live channel is down; names of new members are fetched when they appear. Tests: test:presence 35 (new), test:live 47 (presence before follow, change reaches others, closed connection leaves; mutation caught), e2e 09 presence scenario
- Live channel in the app (R2, spec 17ah-17ay): main keeps one WebSocket to <server>/microsync/live (electron/sync/live.js: auth first, token sent again before it expires, sub per open synced project, backoff 1..30 s, 4503/4409/4400 or a server never ready wait 5 min, 4401 refreshes the token, a sub every minute as the liveness check, connect timeout, closes at logout); sync:live-follow / unfollow + sync:live events. The controller polls at once on a notice from someone else (Automatic pulls, Manual only counts), on access and parked notices, and after a reconnect; polls every 5 min while live, 30 s / 2 min while not. Push about 1 s after an edit is finished instead of 3 s after the last change (17aj). Changes waiting while an edit is open are pulled when it closes, with 'Ben made 3 changes; they'll appear when you close this dialog' (17ap). Chip popover: 'Live updates paused, checking every 30 s' (17ao). main.log records notice to pull times (17av). STRABO_E2E_POLL_MS for e2e. npm run test:live 44 checks against the dev strabo-live (5 mutations caught); test:sync-chip 78
- Activity panel: 'Full history on StraboSpot...' at the bottom opens the website history page (stage 5d-3, 17ae) at <bound server>/micro_history?project_id=<pid>, using the server and project number of the copy's sync binding; the website asks for a login when needed and returns to the page. historyPageUrl in activityFeed.ts; test:activity-feed 33 (mutation-checked)
- Web viewer: a project deleted from StraboSpot by its owner shows 'This project was deleted' (410) instead of a broken viewer, also after the purge (stage 6c, 17ad; uses www microdb/lib/sync_guard.php from server commit fdb33c3, so deploy it after that server code). index.php is copied as-is to www/microview/ (no vite build)
- Delete from StraboSpot (stage 6b; 17p, 17ac): the owner's Collaborators dialog offers Delete from StraboSpot...: unsynced changes are pushed first (a failed push blocks it), then it says what happens (members' copies become separate; restorable from My StraboMicro Data for 30 days), warns about changes not accepted, asks keep a copy here (default) or remove it, and needs the project name typed; IPC sync:delete-project. The server's 410 project_deleted reaches the app as access_removed with removal.deleted (byMe, deletedBy, restorableUntil), so a member's copy, and the owner's copies on other computers, stop syncing and become separate like a removal, with the notice 'Deleted From StraboSpot': '<owner> deleted <name> from StraboSpot ...' (or 'You deleted ...' with the restore date), plus 'Your changes that had not synced are kept in this copy.' when there were any. Tests: test:collaborators 76 (two mutations caught); sync suites green
- Owner review of parked changes (stage 5c; 17o, 17x-17aa): "Dan's 4 unsynced changes are waiting for your review" in the Activity panel and the sync chip popover (count badge on the chip, from the activity poll's parkedCount) opens Changes waiting for your review: per item the member's values next to the project now, Accept (applied as my own undoable edit, newer work kept; a new item with what was created inside it is one unit) or Discard, Accept all / Discard all; blocked with the reason when its parent was deleted since, or for new micrographs and point count sessions (their files are not in the parked change); decisions go to the server and accepted changes are pushed with onBehalfOf (sidecar onBehalf). src/utils/parkedReview.ts, ParkedReviewDialog, IPC sync:parked / sync:review-parked. Tests: test:parked-review 22, test:collaborators 65 (mutation-checked)
- Restore in the activity panel (stage 5b; 17n, 17w): a deletion line offers Restore to Owners and Editors, and to a Contributor for their own deletions; the restore (with what was deleted with it) goes to the server, then Sync Now brings the items back; a refused restore says why (what it was in is deleted too, someone else's deletion, items others created). IPC sync:restore-deleted. Tests: test:activity-feed 29, test:collaborators 58 (mutation-checked)
